    if name.endswith('METADATA'):
        data=data.decode().replace('Version: 0.1.0','Version: 0.2.0').encode()
    zout.writestr(name,data)
zout.close()
os.remove(src); os.remove('packages/vectorops-0.1.0.tar.gz')
print('republished as 0.2.0 only')
EOF
